spans.s:
शेखर शेखर, अस्, m. (fr. शिखर; the
more usual form would be शैखर), a crest, chap-
let, diadem, crown, tuft, garland of flowers worn on
the top of the head; a peak, summit; the chief or
head of anything (generally at the end of comps.);
a particular Dhruva or recurring stanza of a song,
(another kind is called लघु-शेखर); a proper
N.; (अम्), n. cloves; the root of the Hyperanthera
Moringa.

शेखरित, अस्, आ, अम्, crested, tufted, topped,
peaked.
शेखरी, f. a particular parasitical plant (= वन्दा).
